The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```java
FSDataInputStream i = (FSDataInputStream)super.getInputStream(item);
switch(i.readShort()) {
    case 0x1f8b: { // RFC 1952
```
Reason:
The code reads the stream without resetting its position. If the input stream is not at the beginning, calling `i.readShort()` could read data from an arbitrary position, leading to incorrect type detection and potentially causing the program to misinterpret the stream's content, especially if it is compressed.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
i.seek(0);
```
Reason:
The `i.seek(0);` statement resets the position of the input stream back to the beginning before any reading occurs. This ensures that the stream starts processing from the correct position, eliminating the risk of reading incorrect data and resolving the bug related to stream handling.
